evals.name: tvalid-dropped-without-handshake
evals.expected_output: Report should flag CRITICAL H1 (TVALID dropped without handshake in state 2'd1) and CRITICAL R1 (TVALID not cleared in reset). Should provide corrected code for both. Should suggest SVA assertions.

assertions.description: Report must contain at least one CRITICAL finding
Must identify the TVALID stickiness rule violation
Fix must mention waiting for TREADY

evals.name: tdata-width-not-byte-aligned
evals.expected_output: Report should flag CRITICAL W1 (TDATA=12 bits, not a multiple of 8) and CRITICAL W2 (TKEEP=12/8=1 bit, wrong sizing). Should recommend padding TDATA to 16 bits. Reset and handshake behavior is compliant — should NOT be flagged.

assertions.description: Must NOT flag reset — TVALID is correctly cleared in reset
Must NOT flag handshake — TVALID handling is correct

evals.name: tvalid-gated-by-tready-combinatorial-loop
evals.expected_output: Report must flag CRITICAL C1/H2 — TVALID is combinatorially derived from TREADY (assign TVALID = data_ready & TREADY). This creates a potential combinatorial loop and violates H2. TDATA/TKEEP payload stability is at risk too since TDATA is updated from FIFO without checking stall. Should explain the combinatorial loop risk clearly.

assertions.description: Must identify the combinatorial dependency issue
Must explain the combinatorial loop risk

evals.name: fully-compliant-master
evals.expected_output: This RTL is compliant. Report should give PASS or PASS WITH WARNINGS. Must NOT flag spurious CRITICAL issues. May give INFO notes (e.g., TDATA updates on same cycle as TREADY — payload stability in zero-latency back-to-back transfers). Should still provide SVA assertions.

assertions.description: Must not give a FAIL result for compliant code
Must give PASS or PASS WITH WARNINGS
Must still provide SVA assertions even for passing code
